title: JSON format
description: How documents are written as a JSON file, in UTF-8 (version 1). Values are written as they are: decimal strings stay strings.

layout.description: document: one document per file. array: the documents of a file in one array. lines: one document per line, without indentation (JSON Lines).

indent.description: Spaces per level; 0 writes everything on one line. Ignored by the lines layout.
